question: Should OpenClaw accept `currentTokenCount` plus the new harness-runtime helper exports as stable ContextEngine/plugin SDK API now, or fold this token-budget contract into the broader assemble metadata design in issue #82137?
rationale: The PR changes plugin-facing API contracts while a broader assemble metadata RFC is still open, and automation cannot choose the permanent public contract for third-party context engines.

options.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Repair
options.body: Land the optional `currentTokenCount` contract after the SDK baseline is regenerated and the contributor provides real long-session context-engine proof.

options.title: Fold Into Broader RFC
options.body: Keep this PR paused and handle token-count metadata together with provenance and pre-prompt boundary metadata in issue #82137.

options.title: Keep Helpers Private For Now
options.body: Avoid new SDK exports until maintainers are ready to commit to these helper contracts for external plugin authors.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Repair
recommendation.body: Land the optional `currentTokenCount` contract after the SDK baseline is regenerated and the contributor provides real long-session context-engine proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned reviewer and documented owner for Compaction and Context Engine decisions.
